desc:
⚠️ This game is in alpha so please report bugs. Lots more content coming soon!

Welcome to Magnet Fishing!

🔹 Fish for rare and limited treasures!
🔹 Improve your magnets and rods to increase your luck
🔹 Travel to different locations filled with quests, special items, and events!
🔹 Use your finds to decorate your home and make it your collector's paradise!
🔹 Use potions to enhance your luck and increase your chances of pulling up shiny or ultra-rare items!

Leave a like if you enjoyed it!
